tvShow.name: Bookish
tvShow.overview: Gabriel Book, proprietor of an antiquarian bookshop, relies on his vast collection to unravel baffling cases. He nurtures a group of lovable yet troubled individuals, providing informal protection and guidance.

episodes.name: Slightly Foxed (1)
episodes.overview: There's a new assistant to train up at Book's Books, but the excavation of a nearby bombsite that's full of skeletons leads to book-selling taking a back seat.

episodes.name: Slightly Foxed (2)
episodes.overview: Bliss and Book's investigation into Harkup's death continues as Book discovers some surprising evidence in the case of the bombsite skeletons.

episodes.name: Deadly Nitrate (1)
episodes.overview: There's excitement in the air when a film crew arrives at Archangel Lane - until an extra drops dead after eating poisoned chocolates meant for one of the cast.

episodes.name: Deadly Nitrate (2)
episodes.overview: Book must race against time to uncover the truth before anyone else ends up dead. Meanwhile, Jack gets an unexpected answer when he confronts Trottie and Book.

episodes.name: Such Devoted Sisters (1)
episodes.overview: A grand hotel, exiled royalty, a poisoned army captain and Trottie as a suspect. Could this prove to be Book’s toughest case yet?

episodes.name: Such Devoted Sisters (2)
episodes.overview: As tension builds, the staff rebel and the Walsingham Hotel lists like an old ship, can Book unmask Captain Orr’s murderer?

episodes.name: Memento Mori - Part 1
episodes.overview: When a charismatic medium hosts a mysterious seance, a table full of suspects are under investigation as Book reunites with Inspector Bliss to solve the mystery.

episodes.name: Memento Mori - Part 2
episodes.overview: The evidence forces Book and the team to face a disturbing question: has a notorious fascist who ended up on the gallows returned from the grave to kill again?

episodes.name: Dead Man's Whistle - Part 1
episodes.overview: Inspector Bliss and Book are unconvinced when a body is found in unusual circumstances in a tailor's shop and the elderly proprietor is keen to confess. Contains Mature Themes.

episodes.name: Dead Man's Whistle - Part 2
episodes.overview: As Jack's good fortune runs out, Book and the team decipher the handiwork of a tailor who is capable of much more than a stylish new suit. Contains Mature Themes.

episodes.name: Killer Nacht - Part 1
episodes.overview: On a mission to stop a notorious book thief - the elusive Duchess Alberta (Miranda Richardson) - Book and Jack journey across post-war Germany to the town of Wurl. Contains Mature Themes.

episodes.name: Killer Nacht - Part 2
episodes.overview: With Book and Jack caught in the jaws of a deadly legacy in Germany, Inspector Bliss and local officer Liesl Pohl cross-examine the guests of the Schloss Von Bode. Contains Mature Themes.
